title: Re: Collecting Souls of Whiskers Past
description: Re: Collecting Souls of Whiskers Past — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Rattle Tooths's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel. When you have them all return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Rattle Tooths's Vengeful Soul in Rattle Tooth's Revenge to collect Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Sissirat's Vengeful Soul to collect Sissirat's Soul in a Baubel. Kill Vergrim's Vengeful Soul to collect Vergrim's Soul in a Baubel. When you have them all return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

We have learned some important things, you and I. Ratsputin can trap souls and use them to make himself more powerful. Whiskers are inherently vengeful. I really can't beat Puzzle Runner II Turbo HD Extreme without those Soul crystals. All important life lessons, wouldn't you agree. So, as long as you keep bringing me those Souls I will eventually get them over to the Townston Alchemical Association so they can use them to weaken Ratsputin, blah, blah, blah. Boooooring!

You know the drill, here is what I need: Rattle Tooth's Soul, Sissirat's Soul, and Vergrim's Soul. Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Rattle Tooth's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section in Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Sissirat's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Sissirat's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Edict Section in Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Vergrim's Soul in a Bauble can be found in Vergrim's Revenge, which is located off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section in Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Come back to Townston and talk to me, the Townston Commander, when you have the power gems...I mean the Souls in Baubel.

Turn-in:

Excellent, let me wrap up this game of Puzzle Runner II Turbo HD Extreme. While I'm doing that, would you want to do this quest again?

Objectives:

  • Rattle Tooth's Soul in a Bauble ×1
  • Sissirat's Soul in a Bauble ×1
  • Vergrim's Soul in a Bauble ×1

Level range: 81–100
